subject: Request: Cross-cloud listing concession & pilot discount for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: MarketplaceOps <acme-marketplace@acmecorp.com>; PortfolioAdmin <portfolio@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot listing — request for initial marketplace concession

Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration looks solid. We have a cautious internal timetable for the Q2 pilot (starts April 1) and the marketplace team is asking for a short-term listing concession to make the SKU competitive in their buyer flows.

Specifically they're requesting: 15% introductory discount on the marketplace SKU for 90 days and a one-time listing credit to cover accelerated publish fees. We understand this is outside standard marketplace pricing, so they asked us to escalate to the vendor (you) for approval.

Attached is their sandbox listing checklist (acme_mop.pdf) and our draft pricing worksheet. Let me know what flexibility you have and any info they need from our side (sales forecast, ARR commitments, etc.).

Cheers,
Mike
Mike Jenkins
Sr. Partner Manager, Acme Marketplace
Acme Corporation

Attachments: acme_mop.pdf (application/pdf), pricing_worksheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot listing — request for initial marketplace concession

Forwarding Acme's ask — they want 15% for 90 days + publish credit. Pilot starts 2027-04-01.

Quick context: Acme is a strategic co-sell target for our marketplace play; this pilot could open multiple enterprise listings across portfolios. The listing team says price parity in buyer UI materially affects win rate.

Questions for deal desk: 1) Can we grant a time-limited 15% introductory discount on the marketplace SKU without changing our public catalogue price? 2) If not, can we offer a one-time marketplace credit (billing credit) to offset listing fees and keep the SKU price standard? 3) Any approval matrix items (finance signoff, marketplace program constraints)?

I've attached the pricing worksheet they sent — estimate of expected commit and estimated pilot spend is on tab 'Forecast'.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_worksheet.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot listing — request for initial marketplace concession

Sergio / Vanessa —

Summarizing from Deal Desk and Finance POV after a quick sync: 15% off-catalog discount for 90 days is allowable as a limited promotional concession but needs a short-term approval path:

- Approval required: Revenue Ops + Finance Director for credits > $25k estimated cost.
- Recommended alternative: issue a capped marketplace credit (billing credit) not to exceed the expected difference in realized revenue; this preserves catalog pricing and keeps marketplace reporting clean.
- We should require a minimal MOP (mutual action plan) and a forecast commit (they have a 3-month target in the worksheet).

Action items I propose:
1) Sergio: get Acme to sign the mutual action plan and confirm pilot start/end dates.
2) Vanessa: can you prepare the draft credit memo template (capped to $40k) and confirm Finance contact?
3) Marissa: loop Legal for a short addendum that ties the credit to pilot metrics and prevents list price changes.

If we get agreement, I can fast-track approval with Finance (I have 30k delegated authority; anything above needs Finance Director sign-off).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot listing — request for initial marketplace concession

Hi Mike —

Thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet. We can accommodate a short-term concession via a capped marketplace credit tied to the pilot. Proposed terms:

- Credit: up to $40,000 applied as a billing credit during the pilot period (does not change public SKU price).
- Duration: covers pilot period 2027-04-01 through 2027-06-30.
- Requirements: signed MOP, pilot KPIs (activation, MAU target), and a one-page addendum binding the credit to those KPIs.
- Approval path: Finance needs to review; Karthik has delegated $30k approval. For amounts above $30k, Finance Director must sign off.

We can move quickly if Acme signs the MOP and returns the forecast tab. If you prefer a straight percentage off the SKU in the marketplace UI, note that changes take 10 business days to propagate and would require product catalog updates — we recommend the billing credit for speed and auditability.

Next step: I'll draft the credit memo and addendum and share a DocuSign link for signatures once we have confirm on the cap and KPIs.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_worksheet.xlsx

From: Mike Jenkins <mike.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot listing — request for initial marketplace concession

Vanessa,

That works for Acme — they prefer the capped billing credit approach. I've attached the signed MOP (see attachment) and the updated Forecast tab. We're aiming to finalize the DocuSign by EOD Friday so listing and marketing can align.

We'll need the DocuSign for the credit addendum and the billing code to be applied to the first invoice post-launch. Also, please confirm if Redwood can issue the credit as an invoice adjustment or whether it will appear as an account-level credit in their payment portal.

Thanks everyone — we appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Mike Jenkins
Sr. Partner Manager, Acme Marketplace

Attachments: acme_mop_signed.pdf, pricing_worksheet_updated.xlsx
